page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. This processor operates at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz and features 32 physical cores and 32 vCPUs, with a single thread per core allocation. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage options and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. Virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.hfg6.8xlarge in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. The system achieved a stress-ng multi-core CPU performance score of 30666.35 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 11107.0. Memory performance tests show a read-only small block bandwidth of 1705.41 GB/sec and a large block write speed of 48.22 GB/sec. In database operations, the instance processed 28.91 million Redis SET operations per second and scored 11442.59 on PassMark database benchmarks. For specialized tasks, it demonstrated a static web serving throughput of 21.45 GB/sec and processed 45.98 tokens per second for prompt processing on a medium 7B LLM model.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density make this instance suitable for workloads requiring consistent compute power without the overhead of hyperthreading. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs represents a tradeoff, requiring external storage configuration and limiting its utility for heavy deep learning training. However, the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and solid memory bandwidth make it well-suited for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded software compilation, database operations, web serving, and moderate-sized language model inference.
